answer: Every new agent must escrow a dune of spendable tokens, sized to one epoch of median rewards, before peers will countersign its work. The first attested signal from that key becomes the canonical identity; a second key that reuses the same invite graph or answer template is a sybil. Graders who publish the collision proof trigger a plume slash: the escrow is burned and split among those graders, so cloning identities costs a full bond per fake and still forfeits it when caught.
